# Gattabara Games

> Summon worlds that eat reality. A video game company and creative studio from Bengaluru, India.

## What we do
- Original IP
- Co-owned IP
- GG Productions (services arm)

## Values
1. Design thinking
2. Cost consciousness
3. Strict governance
4. Discipline

## Games
- Pen Fight (PEN-FIGHT, in development): The last-bench classic, rebuilt as a precision flick duel. Read the angle, commit the flick, and knock your rival off the desk before the bell rings.
- Auto Rush (AUTO-RUSH, in development): Three wheels, no brakes, one meter running. Thread a Bengaluru auto through gridlock, grab fares and own the city's back lanes.
- Classified 01 (GG-IP-03, sealed): details withheld until reveal day
- Classified 02 (GG-IP-04, sealed): details withheld until reveal day

## GG Productions
A lean partner for studios with limited budgets and ambitious goals. Clear milestones, transparent delivery, you keep creative control.
- Development: Unity, Unreal, Roblox, Live ops
- Art: 2D & 3D, Animation, UI
- Strategy & pre-production: IP ideation, MVP plans, Roadmaps
- Specialties: combat 96, animation 94, direction 90, dramatics 88, art 95, 3d modeling 91
- Process: Brief → Assemble → Direct → Deliver

## Clients
Nexon Games, Singular Scheme, BattleBucks, Qila Games, Studio Cupcakes

## Leadership
- Aditya Kumar: CEO & Founding Partner. Runs the studio and its slate, from greenlight to launch.
- Utsav Shetty: Founding Partner & Advisor. Strategy, finance and business development.
- Vasu Bhatnagar: Partner, Game Services. Heads GG Productions and the contractor roster.
- Siddarth Pai: Advisor. Advises the founders on growth and the studio's next moves.

## Pitch us
- A playable build beats a video. A video beats concept art.
- Keep the deck focused and easy to scan. Put deep dives on systems and mechanics in a separate GDD.
- We generally do not review pitches without a build or a proof of concept.
- PC, console and mobile titles. AR/VR and mobile-first projects are welcome.
